description: This file contains functions for post-processing AI-generated code completions, including filtering out unwanted outputs, removing markdown code blocks, and handling model-specific adjustments.

methods.name: rewritesLineAbove
methods.description: Checks if the completion rewrites the line above the prefix.

methods.name: isExtremeRepetition
methods.description: Detects if the completion contains excessive repeated lines.

methods.name: isOnlyWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if the completion consists solely of whitespace.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the completion is empty or only whitespace.

methods.name: removeBackticks
methods.description: Removes markdown code block delimiters from the completion.

methods.name: postprocessCompletion
methods.description: Main function that filters and adjusts the completion based on various criteria and model-specific rules.
